S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  CRLA No. 593 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
(1) Ms. Sangeeta Adhikari Patni, learned counsel for the appellant.
(2) Mr. K.S. Bora, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State of Uttarakhand.

(3) This appeal is filed under Section 415(2) of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 against the judgment and order dated 01.08.2024 rendered by learned Special Sessions Judge (POCSO)/Sessions Judge, District Champawat in Session Trial No. 15 of 2019, whereby appellant has been convicted under Section 363 of I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act, 2012 read with Section 376 of I.P.C. He has been directed to undergo rigorous imprisonment for three years under Section 363 I.P.C. with fine of 10,000/- and, in default of payment of fine, he was sentenced to undergo further three months simple imprisonment; he has also been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for twenty years under Section 376(3) I.P.C.
with fine of 50,000/- and, in default of payment of fine, he was sentenced to undergo further one year simple imprisonment.
